events.title: Fear & Greed fell into extreme fear (20)

messages.text:
**Daily Market Summary · 13 November 2026**

**Alert**
• Fear & Greed fell into extreme fear (20, from 28 yesterday). The mood is at its most worried level, so expect users to be cautious this week.

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin about $71,514, down about 5.7% over 7 days and about 12% over 30 days.
• Headline: BULLISH, medium confidence (long-run uptrend still counts), but price has slipped about 2% under its 200-day average ($73,058).
• Fear & Greed 20 (extreme fear), while many people are still betting on a rise with borrowed money.

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Bitcoin fell below $72,000 on the day Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang stepped down and US crypto-related and tech stocks fell broadly (PANews); no other single cause is reported.
• About $751M of futures bets were forced to close in 24 hours, mostly bets on a rise (PANews). US Bitcoin funds saw about $487M leave on the latest day.

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
Soft to neutral: price has been under its 50-day average for 23 days.
• Turns up: a close above $73,058 (200-day average), then $80,625 (50-day average).
• Sideways: between $69,500 and $73,058; a normal week swings about $4,069.
• Turns down: a close below $69,500, then $68,108 (200-week average) and $62,819 (90-day low).
• Rally watch: drop window open (since 11 November). A rally signal needs about $81,912; a fresh drop signal comes below about $69,776.
• Dates: Russia crypto trading from 22 November, OKXICE launch 23 November, Fed meeting 8 December.

**News that matters**
• US DOJ froze about $2.7B stolen from Binance; Binance says affected assets are covered (Bloomberg via PANews): short term, positive.
• Nvidia CEO exit knocked tech stocks (PANews): short term, negative.
• US Treasury plans bank-style checks on stablecoin issuers (PANews): medium term, small negative.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Big institutions keep building: DTCC plans to connect tokenization to Solana, BNY adds staking (PANews); SOL -2.1% in 24h.
• New on Reku: Babylon (BABY): the project says Aave's community voted to accept native Bitcoin as collateral through Babylon.

**Bigger picture**
• Next month: mixed; needs $80,625 to firm up. 3-6 months: still leans up, but needs a close back above $73,058; $68,108 is the next floor.

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Paid / Digital · 13 Nov**
• Hold trader-targeted spend and keep a reserve: a Rally watch drop window is open and Bitcoin is about 2% under its 200-day average ($73,058). No step-up until a close back above it, and a bigger push only above $80,625.
• Apply a d30 ROI stop-loss on running campaigns while the drop window is open.
• Lean new-user ads on trust and learning (Fear & Greed 20), and keep rally creatives ready in case price reaches about $81,912.

**Social & content · 13 Nov**
• Keep the normal rhythm with calm, factual posts: Bitcoin is about $71,514, down about 12% in a month.
• Explain why crypto fell with tech stocks: PANews reported Bitcoin under $72,000 the day Nvidia's CEO stepped down.
• Trust piece: the US DOJ froze about $2.7B stolen from Binance and Binance says affected assets are covered (Bloomberg via PANews).

**CRM · 13 Nov**
• Send existing holders a calm market note (Bitcoin about 12% lower over the month, just under its 200-day average) with a link to an explainer and no push to trade.
• Send a security reminder on fake wallet messages: SafePal order data was used in a phishing scam (Pluang) and Trezor reported tampered devices (PANews).
• Keep welcome and education journeys running; hold deposit promotions while the drop window is open.

**SEO · 13 Nov**
• Why Bitcoin is falling (High): Pintu ('Kenapa Bitcoin Turun? Faktor Makro di Balik Koreksi November 2026') and Pluang both covered it; refresh the 'why is Bitcoin down today' page, likely to draw searches after the fall under $72,000.
• December Fed meeting (High): Pintu has an FOMC December explainer; publish a plain 'what the 8 December Fed meeting means for crypto' page.
• Tokenized stocks (High): Pintu and Pluang both wrote on OKX-ICE, Binance and Hyperliquid stock trading; refresh the guide before OKXICE launches on 23 November.
Indodax could not be read today. Check against Reku's pages. https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Altcoins · 13 Nov**
• Tech-stock shock: Nvidia's CEO exit hit US tech and crypto-related stocks (PANews); BTC -3.5%, ETH -1.9%, SOL -2.1% in 24h.
• Binance hack recovery: the US DOJ froze about $2.7B of stolen funds (Bloomberg via PANews); BNB -3.4%.
• New on Reku: Babylon (BABY): according to the project, Aave's community voted to accept native Bitcoin as collateral through Babylon. DODO is up about 22% in 24h with no stated reason (project X quiet since 30 October).
